templates.title: Roadmap
templates.description: The one document that says where the service is heading and whether it is getting there.

templates.title: Goal
templates.description: A change in what people do, with a starting value and a target, held for one to two years.

templates.title: Idea
templates.description: Any suggestion, from anyone, with no commitment attached.

templates.title: Small request
templates.description: A bounded change to something that already exists, finished in less than a sprint, that doesn't advance a roadmap goal.

templates.title: Initiative
templates.description: The tracked bet that pursuing an opportunity will advance a goal.
templates.changes: Open until the outcome is reached

templates.title: Solution
templates.description: One way the team tries to reach an Initiative's outcome: an output that gets tested, built, kept or dropped.

templates.title: Discovery brief
templates.description: The one-page summary of a round of discovery inside an Initiative: what we set out to learn, who we listened to, which Solutions we considered and what we decided about each.

templates.title: Assumption log
templates.description: The running list of what must be true for a Solution to work, how we tested each assumption, and whether it held.

templates.title: Deliverable
templates.description: A tangible thing handed over, so a commitment can be checked as met or not.

templates.title: Epic
templates.description: A flexible container the team uses to group related user stories.

templates.title: User story
templates.description: The smallest piece of value the team builds, described from the user's side.

templates.title: Sprint report
templates.description: The part of the roadmap updated every sprint: whether the sprint goal was met, where each commitment stands, and what is blocked.

templates.title: Release notes
templates.description: Messages that tell staff, partners and the public what changed, written for the person whose experience changes.

templates.title: Launch readiness check
templates.description: Before a launch, a short go/no-go question to every group the launch affects: are you ready?

templates.title: Enable plan
templates.description: How we make sure people can succeed with what was released: what we teach, who champions it, and how we listen.
